theme.title: Lakers–Celtics, 2010
theme.subtitle: The 2010 Finals
theme.recap: The rivalry's latest Finals went seven games, with Ray Allen setting a record one night and missing everything two nights later.

questions.prompt: Phil Jackson won the 2010 title as Lakers coach. How many titles had he won as a head coach in total?

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Lakers head coach Phil Jackson earned his 11th NBA championship title

funFacts.text: That championship was Phil Jackson's first Finals Game 7 as a head coach despite his long title-winning career.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: as well as head coach Phil Jackson’s first-ever Finals Game 7

funFacts.text: Boston was one victory from reclaiming the trophy when it traveled to Los Angeles for Game 6.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: The Lakers returned to Los Angeles with a 3–2 deficit in the series

funFacts.text: Kobe Bryant was Finals MVP for a second consecutive year as the Lakers repeated as champions.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Kobe Bryant was named the Most Valuable Player of the Finals for the second consecutive year

questions.prompt: How many threes did Ray Allen make in Game 2 of the 2010 Finals?
questions.context: 2010 NBA Finals · Game 2 · at Los Angeles
questions.note: Eight, on 11 attempts, a Finals record at the time.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Allen hit eight of 11 three-pointers, breaking a Finals record

funFacts.text: Ray Allen's barrage featured a second-quarter shooting display in which he barely missed from deep.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: In the 2nd quarter, Ray Allen hit an impressive five three-pointers (only missing once)

funFacts.text: Rajon Rondo also delivered a triple-double in Boston's road win at Staples Center.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Rondo finished with an impressive triple-double of 19 points, 12 rebounds and 10 assists

funFacts.text: The series was tied after Boston's win, the first Finals to reach that position since Lakers–Pistons in 2004.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: The last Finals series to be tied at 1–1 after two games was the 2004 NBA Finals

questions.prompt: Two days after his record night, Ray Allen went 0-for-how-many from the field in Game 3?

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Ray Allen went a near-record 0–13 in field goals for this game.

funFacts.text: Derek Fisher rescued Los Angeles late in Game 3, carrying most of his scoring in the fourth quarter.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Derek Fisher scored 11 of his 16 points in the fourth quarter

funFacts.text: Singer Monica performed the national anthem before the first Finals game at Boston's arena that year.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Prior to the starting lineups being announced, singer Monica performed the national anthem

funFacts.text: Kevin Garnett hit Boston's opening baskets, but Los Angeles put together a strong first-half response.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Kevin Garnett scored the first six points of the game

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Perkins tore both his PCL and MCL, and he was ruled out for Game 7
